description: Configure a pinned public speaker, explicit monitoring objective, and structured asset-impact research hypotheses. The model reads every statement and decides relevance, the affected market, and the implied direction; the hypotheses are strategy guidance, not a keyword filter.

configuration.label: Timezone
configuration.description: Timezone used for activity and budget windows.

configuration.label: Tracker name
configuration.description: Owner-visible name for this monitoring hypothesis.

configuration.label: X account
configuration.description: Resolve a handle or profile URL, then confirm the display name and pinned numeric X user ID before saving. Sensitive-event presets use the approved first-party fallback instead of X.

configuration.label: Monitoring objective
configuration.description: Plain-language statement of what explicit public commentary should match.
configuration.default: Detect statements suggesting escalation, de-escalation, war, negotiations, ceasefire, or peace involving Iran.

configuration.label: Topics and entities
configuration.description: Bounded topics or entities that scope what the owner cares about. They guide the model and are not required to appear verbatim in a statement.

configuration.label: Impact hypotheses
configuration.description: Each row is a relevant outcome, affected asset, and expected up/down pressure. These guide the model on what the owner cares about; the market a statement is actually about is read from the statement. A research hypothesis is not a guaranteed relationship or automatic trade.

configuration.label: Polling cadence
configuration.description: Enabling runs immediately over this preceding interval; later runs collect every unseen statement from the durable checkpoint.

configuration.label: Optional asset filter
configuration.description: Empty means all assets resolved by the configured hypotheses; a nonempty list filters alerts only.

configuration.label: Minimum materiality
configuration.description: Deterministic score required before a research alert.

configuration.label: Minimum confidence
configuration.description: Lowest semantic confidence eligible for an alert.

configuration.label: Replies
configuration.description: Whether direct replies may be evaluated.

configuration.label: Quote posts
configuration.description: Whether the configured speaker's own text on quote posts may be evaluated.

configuration.label: Exa corroboration
configuration.description: Optional metadata-only corroboration; weak or unavailable coverage stays visible with a warning.

configuration.label: Alerts
configuration.description: Enable research alerts. The first cadence backfill produces at most one cited summary alert.

skills.description: Apply the configured identity, objective, topics, impact hypotheses, and abstention rules through the shared Spec 4C pipeline.
